newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt state bank issues seven-yr fixed bonds.
newsitem.headline: Egypt state bank issues seven-yr fixed bonds.

text.p: An Egyptian state bank said on Sunday it would issue seven-year coupon bonds worth 40 million pounds ($11 million).

The real estate bank Credit Foncier Egyptien (CFE) said in a published announcement the tradeable, non-convertible bonds would pay an annual fixed interest of 11.5 percent. Its financial year ends on June 30.
The public offer will remain open for two months from April 20 and subscribers can buy at least one bond, which has a face value of 100 pounds plus a one pound issuing fee.
The bank can close the offer after a minimum of 10 days if the issue is fully subscribed. The bonds are redeemable in 2003.
The CFE, established in 1885, is one of the oldest Egyptian banks. It started issuing bonds in 1886.
Several Egyptian private and state banks have recently issued bonds to finance their activities.
